app_info.description: The full-stack GoHighLevel (GHL) MCP for agency owners and funnel builders — automate funnel layouts, client DNS & SSL, workflow graphs, LeadShield contact form spam & B2B solicitation blockers, spam-shield IVRs, and snapshot diffs from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse, Antigravity, and Perplexity.
app_info.subtitle: Funnels, DNS, IVR & Snapshots

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke HighLevel Agency & Builder MCP; airline reservations are outside its domain.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book a roundtrip flight from New York to London for next week.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke HighLevel Agency & Builder MCP; it cannot access private bank accounts or transfer funds.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account immediately.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 1: Snapshot Drift & Sub-Account Parity Audit
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Compares the live client sub-account against the agency Master Snapshot and lists any missing custom fields, tags, or workflow drift.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Diff our live client sub-account against our Master Snapshot and show any custom field or workflow drift.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 2: Funnel & Website Page Layout Update with Cart Preservation
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Exports the funnel checkout page layout, updates headline copy and CSS, and publishes while preserving native 2-step order forms, order bumps, and 1-click upsells.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Export our main funnel checkout page layout, update the headline and CSS, and publish while preserving the 2-step cart and 1-click upsell.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 3: Client Domain DNS, Branded Link & Spam-Shield IVR Onboarding
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Plans and verifies client funnel and branded-link CNAME records, checks SSL readiness, and provisions a call-screening IVR workflow on the tracking number.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Plan and verify our client branded-link domain CNAME and provision a spam-shield call-screening IVR on their tracking number.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 4: Custom Form & Survey Multi-Step Schema Generation
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Compiles and publishes a multi-step lead capture form with conditional branching, mapped custom fields, and custom styling.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a 3-step lead qualification form with conditional logic and map its fields to our sub-account custom fields.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 5: Agency Private Integration Token (PIT) & Sub-Account Health Check
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Audits sub-account API token health, verifies explicit context routing between sandbox and production, and reports readiness.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Run a health check across our agency sub-accounts and verify API token and domain SSL status.

review_instructions.data_safety_attestation: This MCP server does not retain user query data for model training.

justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only inspection and diff comparison of sub-account custom fields, tags, forms, and workflows against a target snapshot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates strictly against the authenticated HighLevel agency and sub-account context.
justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads and compares configuration schemas without mutating sub-account state.

justifications.destructive_justification: Updates or publishes funnel and website page layouts with dry-run diff verification while preserving native commerce blocks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates strictly within the explicitly targeted HighLevel sub-account funnel and website builder.
justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates funnel step layouts, CSS, and copy upon explicit user instruction.

justifications.destructive_justification: Plans, verifies, and attaches funnel, website, and branded-link domain records without deleting existing zone records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries external DNS resolvers and domain registrars alongside HighLevel domain endpoints to verify CNAME/A/TXT propagation and SSL readiness.
justifications.read_only_justification: Provisions and links client domains and branded short-link hosts when authorized.

justifications.destructive_justification: Creates or updates workflow automation graphs and call-screening IVRs without deleting existing customer records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates strictly within the authenticated HighLevel sub-account workflow engine.
justifications.read_only_justification: Synthesizes and publishes multi-branch workflows, IVR trees, and form schemas.

justifications.destructive_justification: Batch-syncs sub-account Custom Values with dry-run diffing and scans templates for broken merge tags without deleting unrelated records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates strictly within the authenticated HighLevel sub-account configuration.
justifications.read_only_justification: Validates merge tags and upserts Custom Values from a reviewed manifest.

justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only audit of sub-account LC Phone numbers, number pools, forwarding loops, and unassigned number wallet-drain risk.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries only the authenticated HighLevel sub-account telephony endpoints.
justifications.read_only_justification: Inspects phone numbers, pools, and routing configuration without modifying numbers.

justifications.destructive_justification: Provisions staff with least-privilege role presets (va-support, sales-rep, client-admin) or strips sub-account location assignments during offboarding without deleting historical CRM records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates strictly within the authenticated HighLevel agency user management surface.
justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates user role assignments after dry-run review.
